rd.researchQuestion: Can an IBM 3270-evoking profile be built from the generic CharacterGrid contracts alone, changing presentation tokens but no geometry, order, or semantics?
rd.technicalUncertainty: Whether a dark 3279-inspired palette meets contrast requirements and whether 24x80 and 32x80 geometries work without 3270-specific primitives.
